analysis.summary: Technical effects test showing transition from photorealistic scene to edge-detected version. The crossroads composition (man on road through wheat fields) transforms into white line art on black, demonstrating the edge detection filter that can be used for Veo frame chaining and visual effects.

frames.text: Man standing centered on a long straight road through golden wheat fields. Ethereal ghostly face overlay visible in the sky above. Golden hour sunset lighting. The crossroads/journey composition from the Sagittarius series.

Edge detection filter has transformed the scene into white line art on pure black background. The road, wheat fields, and figure are rendered as glowing outlines, creating an abstract blueprint aesthetic.
Edge detection effect continues - white contour lines trace the road perspective, field textures, and human silhouette against the void. Technical art style emphasizing structure over surface.

characters.name: The Wanderer
characters.description: Solitary man standing on straight road through wheat fields, ghostly face apparition in sky above, surreal/dreamlike quality
